notes_for_editor: Read: two FFLA Virginia county lists, a 2010 Pastmaps map page and the Southampton Heritage Village page. The link between the list's Ag & Forestry Center and the Heritage Village museum is an inference from the names and is not confirmed. Searches found no news or agency record of the tower or its move. A directory site with a Capron tower topo page returned 403 and was not used. The 2010 entry is a map label, not a site visit, so the gone status of the original site is only what the FFLA list says. The destination record us-va-capron-at-southampton-ag-forestry-center.json was not changed.
